We need to identify crimes based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: unqualified person performing fetal sex determination (illegal medical practice) and providing abortion drugs for sex-selective abortion. Likely crimes: illegal medical practice (非法行医) under Criminal Law article 336? Actually article 336: "非法行医罪" for practicing medicine without license. Also "非法进行胎儿性别鉴定" maybe violation of population and family planning law, but criminal? Could be "非法进行胎儿性别鉴定" is administrative. However providing abortion for sex selection may be "非法堕胎" but not a crime? Could be "非法行医罪" and "帮助他人实施堕胎罪"? There's article 302? Actually "组织、强迫、诱骗、教唆他人进行堕胎" maybe not. Could be "非法行医罪" and "非法进行胎儿性别鉴定罪"? Not sure.

Also "非法进行胎儿性别鉴定" may be violation of "计划生育法" but criminal? In China, sex-selective abortion is illegal under population and family planning law, but criminal liability may be "非法进行胎儿性别鉴定罪" (Article 336? No). Might be "非法行医罪" and "非法堕胎罪"? There's "非法堕胎罪" under article 302? Actually article 302 is "组织卖淫". Not.

Search memory: Chinese Criminal Law article 336: "非法行医罪" - practicing medicine without license, causing严重后果 may be punishable. Also article 336 includes "非法进行医学检查、诊断、治疗" etc. So both sex determination and abortion are illegal medical practice.

Thus likely only one crime: illegal medical practice. But also "非法进行胎儿性别鉴定" maybe considered "非法进行计划生育手术" but not separate.

Thus answer: [罪名]非法行医<eoa>
